title: Revoke an MCP token
content_data:
Use this endpoint to revoke an access token or refresh token, allowing you to end a connection early. The endpoint is idempotent. # Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/{server}/oauth/revoke/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | Content-Type {Required} | string | Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. | ``` **Path parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |server {Required}|string|The specific TikTok for Business MCP server URL.

Enum values: `tt-ads-mcp-flat`, `tt-ads-mcp-layer`.

To learn more about how these server URLs differ, see [Choose your server URL](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-a-custom-agent-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3#anchor-3).| ``` ## Example > **Note**
> The example below uses `tt-ads-mcp-layer` as the `{server}` value. You can replace this with your chosen server value. ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer/oauth/revoke' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \ --data-urlencode 'token={{token}}' \ --data-urlencode 'token_type_hint=access_token' (/code) ``` # Response A successful request returns HTTP `200 OK`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | revoked | boolean | Whether your request to revoke the token was successful.

Supported values: `true`, `false`.

Note: This field will return `true` even if you send an unknown, invalid, or already-expired token. This is because the endpoint is idempotent. If the token cannot be used anyway, the server safely ignores it and considers the revocation successful. | ``` ## Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "revoked": true } (/code) ``` ## Error response A failure returns HTTP `400 Bad Request`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | error | string | Error code.

To learn about the possible errors and descriptions, see [List of possible errors](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/revoke-an-mcp-token/v1.3#anchor-2-2-1). | | error_description | string | The human-readable description of the error.

To learn about the possible errors and descriptions, see [List of possible errors](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/revoke-an-mcp-token/v1.3#anchor-2-2-1). | ``` ### List of possible errors ```xtable |error{50%}|error_description{50%}| |---|---| |`invalid_request`|`token is required.`| |`invalid_request`|`token_type_hint invalid`| ```
